subject: storytime
title: Corduroy words
about: Corduroy is a toy bear who waits on a store shelf for someone to take him home, and one night he wanders the store looking for the button that is missing from his overalls. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Don Freeman
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A small bear with a missing button finds the friend he has been waiting for.

Corduroy Lisa bear store
shelf toy button girl
home night lamp bed

little

cards.note: capital C, it is his name; three parts: Cor-dur-oy; or says or, ur says er and oy says oy
capital L, it is her name; the i says ee and the a at the end says uh: Lee-suh
ear says air here, like in pear: bair
s-t blend; ore says or, like in more
sh is one part; l-f at the end
oy says oy, like in boy
tt is one t; two parts: but + ton, the o says u: but-un
ir says er, like in bird
magic e makes o say its name
igh says long i, like in light
ll is two letters, one sound: l
o says u and ey says ee: mun-ee
a says o after w: wont
tt is one t; le says ul: lit-ul
